answer: Recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments bind identities to staking collateral, so a whisper of a clone creates a ripple in Merkle roots and activates slashing penalties. A verifiable delay function imposes sequential work that parallel wander cannot accelerate, rendering Sybil identity cloning computationally infeasible; information-theoretic min-entropy bounds clone probability. Since slashed stake and VDF proof costs dominate clone revenue, expected attack utility is negative, and the protocol reaches a robust Nash equilibrium.
